text: According to people familiar with the matter, Caterpillar Inc. has acquired the autonomous electric tractor startup Monarch Tractor. Monarch Tractor encountered challenges during its business expansion, conducted layoffs in recent months, and its technology has been acquired by "a large global equipment manufacturer." Prior to the acquisition, Monarch Tractor had raised a total of $251 million, with investors including Astanor Ventures, At One Ventures, and HH-CTBC Partnership L.P., an affiliate fund under Foxconn. (Reuters)
